items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Show boy had his hula hoop, twisting around there.

ctx.x: I didn't do any time when a hula hoop come out. Show boy had his hula hoop, twisting around there.
Well you were talking back when we first started talking about hoodoo and stuff, and you said do people, people used to believe in it more than they do today or you said people still believe in it?
